claims.text: The selected sharing layer is trained using a gated sharing cell to filter useless features and an attention sharing cell to focus on valuable features for specific tasks.
The training involves a global loss function that minimizes the cross-entropy of predictions across tasks, with a focus on the task of fake news detection.
The selected sharing layer enhances performance by selectively sharing features between tasks, addressing the issue of integrating useless features.
